description: Windows Dynamic Notch with synchronized lyrics, calendar, reminders, tasks, Pomodoro timer, and animated Raven companion.
notes: The official installer/yata.iss identifies the release as Inno Setup and places Yata.exe and yata-cli.exe directly under the application directory. Scoop uses Inno Setup extraction; it does not execute the vendor setup tasks.

Yata targets Windows x64 and requires the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime. The official installer downloads that runtime when missing, but Scoop's Inno extraction does not run that prerequisite installer; install versions/windowsdesktop-runtime-10.0 separately when needed.
The setup's optional autostart and PATH tasks are not applied by Scoop. User data remains under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Yata. The app's optional update notices are left unchanged.
